newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch builders increased foreign turnover in 1995.
newsitem.headline: Dutch builders increased foreign turnover in 1995.

text.p: The association of Dutch builders with foreign activities NABU said on Friday its members' turnover generated outside the Netherlands grew by 9.7 percent to 7.3 billion guilders in 1995.
"For 1996 (non-Dutch) turnover is expected to rise by nine percent to eight billion guilders," NABU said in a statement. It added this year's order inflow was expected to be in line with 1995 levels.
NABU groups 13 Dutch internationally active construction companies which together represent more than 90 percent of Dutch building activities outside the Netherlands.
